Nifty tune

With a lot of bounce … a question - is there an extra bar right at the beginning of the B section? Or is that a 4 beat rest?

↳ Posted by 2situla on January 13th, 2004.

It’s a 1/4 rest.

↳ Posted by gian marco on January 13th, 2004.

Ben Lennon’s version

I transcribed this tune from Ben’s playing in Miltown in 2001- he has also recorded it on the recently released “Within a Mile of Kilty”. I love his version,which has some elegant double -stopping.

“The Dances at Kinvara” ~ Composed by fiddler Ed Reavy

I can’t believe none of you credited the composer and source, the County Cavan / Philadelphia, Pennsylvania, U.S.A. fiddler and composer Ed Reavy, and to be found in his publication:

“The Collected Compositions of Ed Reavy”
Green Grass Music (Jul 1996)
ISBN-10: 0952837005
ISBN-13: 978-0952837008

page 138, tune #124: “The Dances at Kinvara”

http://www.reavy.us/
http://www.reavy.us/compositions.htm
http://www.reavy.us/Reavycom.abc

X: 124
T: The Dances At Kinvara
R: Barn Dance
C: Ed Reavy
M: 4/4
L: 1/8
Z: Joe Reavy
N: Ed heard of them from a friend, but never visited Kinvara himself. He has long cherished this unfulfilled wish.
